To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of fuzzy methods in risk analysis allows the inclusion of the social factor, which is essential in the definition of risk; the application of the fuzzy Mamdami method allows a quick and simple estimation of the aggravation factor, which can be applied in any city of the world, as long as it has the necessary information; and finally, the application of this method in the case of Barcelona, Spain and in Bogota, Colombia shows that both cities have similar social aggravation values, although
the Mamdami fuzzy method is a good approach for the social aggravation estimation.
the Aggravation coefficient for Barcelona and Bogota are 0.7 and 0.6, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of a fuzzy approach to estimate the aggravation coefficient in urban centers.
the use of classical fuzzy methods to estimate the social aggravation coefficient, and its application in the context of seismic risk assessment.

the application of classical fuzzy methods in order to estimate social aggravation, as well as the use of this estimation in a seismic hazard context, to provide decision-makers with a more comprehensive view of the risk.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of fuzzy methods, as well as other soft-computing techniques, could be very helpful in risk management.
the social aggravation is a very relevant element in risk management.

the proposed methodology is an effective tool that could be used to estimate the social aggravation in any city, and to identify those areas where the social aggravation could be reduced, or where the hazard should be mitigated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in order to achieve a better risk assessment and management, it is necessary that social aggravation be included in risk assessment, and this is possible with fuzzy methods.
, the use of a fuzzy Mamdani approach to estimate the Aggravation coefficient is a good alternative to other methods.

the use of a classical fuzzy method to estimate the social aggravation in the case of seismic hazard in Barcelona and Bogota, allows to obtain a reliable and useful tool to be considered as a complementary indicator to the risk assessment process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social aggravation can be estimated in an urban center, considering its social and physical characteristics and a particular natural hazard.
, the social aggravation coefficient can be estimated in an objective way, by using fuzzy methods, in a way that it can be used in a risk management context.
, in addition to physical vulnerability, it is also necessary to consider the social vulnerability to properly estimate the social aggravation.
